project_type: Flutter mobile app (Android primary, iOS secondary), offline-first local AI caregiving companion
build_system: Flutter toolchain; Kotlin for Android platform channels. Build: `flutter pub get`. Generated files: `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` (required after Drift table changes only). NOTE: `flutter analyze` fails on Windows with `.dart_tool/version` lock error — use `dart analyze lib/` instead (returns 0 issues).
test_framework: flutter_test / dart test. Run: `dart test` (works on Windows). `flutter test` may fail due to `.dart_tool/version` Windows filesystem lock. Test files: `test/` directory.
verification_instructions: 1. `dart analyze lib/` must return 0 issues. 2. `dart test` must pass all tests. 3. Do NOT run `flutter analyze` on Windows — use `dart analyze lib/` instead. 4. Do NOT edit *.g.dart files. 5. Build_runner is only needed after Drift schema changes.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lib/core/database/app_database.g.dart — generated by `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`. Do not edit by hand. Not needed for these bug fixes (no schema changes).
environment_constraints: Windows host. `flutter analyze` fails with .dart_tool/version lock — use `dart analyze lib/` instead. No device available in CI — on-device tests (recording, camera, model inference) must be noted as 'requires device'. Gemma 4 E2B model (~2.9 GB) is NOT present in the repo — must be downloaded via app UI. minSdk=26 in build.gradle.kts but LiteRT requires minSdk 30; DeviceProbe gates this correctly.
contribution_requirements: 1. AI never writes to repositories directly. 2. SOS must never route through AI. 3. Generated files (*.g.dart) must NOT be edited by hand. 4. `flutter analyze` (equivalently `dart analyze lib/`) must be clean. 5. Modify only code required to repair the three target features. 6. Do NOT change: Enable Notifications screen, Lola labels, Message/Capture screen bottom nav, Today screen badges/greeting, Reports screen, Capture screen button positions.
key_patterns: Riverpod StateProvider for localAiEngineProvider; FutureProvider for resolvedEngineProvider. Engine swap in app.dart via ref.listen. AiUnavailable exception class in local_ai_engine.dart. Repositories throw AppException subclasses. Permission checks use permission_handler package. record ^7.1.1: hasPermission() checks only — does NOT request. image_picker ^1.2.4: handles camera permission OS dialog automatically but returns null on denial. flutter_gemma 1.11.3: FlutterGemma.initialize(...) must be called in main() before runApp(), not lazily.
directory_structure: lib/main.dart (entry point), lib/app/ (app.dart MaterialApp.router, router.dart GoRouter, theme.dart), lib/core/ (database Drift, errors, notifications, security, utilities), lib/features/ (one dir per screen: capture, ask, ai_setup, home, medications, measurements, appointments, care_notes, care_brief, handover, reports, settings, family_contacts, emergency, onboarding), lib/services/ai/ (care_summary_service, local/ with engines/, capture/, proposals/, narration/, ask/, model/, proof/, platform/), android/ (app/src/main with AndroidManifest.xml + MainActivity.kt), test/ (mirrors lib/ structure).
